text_block_list.text: On the way back from going out with El Condor Pasa—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the sudden question, Trainer-san,
but do you know much about flowers?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Things like names, or the language of flowers.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, you see... the other day, I ruined the vase
that my roommate Grass had put up in our room...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, I didn't do it on purpose, you know!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I was just practicing some pro wrestling moves, and I ended up kicking a vase...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, El apologized right away, and um...
well, she did forgive me, but..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You cherished it so much,
so I really feel terrible about it...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Along with the vase, I'd like to present some apology flowers too, yes!
choice_data_list: Shall we go buy it together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is that for real, yes!?
Thank you very much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow it is, then!
Please accompany me tomorrow first thing!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!!
Afterward, for El Condor Pasa's sake, I stopped by the library to look up the language of flowers before heading back to my room.

—And so, the next day.
Heading straight to the flower shop...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass knows a lot about flowers, desu,
so I can't just pick any random one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There are a few flowers I know of as well,
but when it comes to giving them as gifts...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is there a flower with a meaning that fits Grass?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is there a flower with a meaning that fits Grass?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, chamomile is the one
often used for tea, right, yes?
The language of flowers varies by region, but chamomile can mean things like "reconciliation" or—
I explained to El Condor Pasa that some flower meanings symbolize the strength to overcome adversity.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, maybe we should just
give a vase and some tea as presents, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Unbowed by adversity... that's Grass for you!
A flower truly worthy of being my rival, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? But wouldn't this
come across like a declaration of war?

I went out to buy chamomile leaves with
El Condor Pasa, who had a somewhat mischievous grin.

—After that, upon receiving the flowers,
Grass Wonder reportedly gave a playful smile and said,
"You mustn't let your guard down, you know."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a cute little flower!
It would definitely look great on Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: By the way, what is the language of flowers for it, DESU?
It said that baby's breath carries meanings such as "gratitude."

Wouldn't it be perfect for Grass Wonder,
who takes care of El Condor Pasa as her roommate?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, that's perfect!
I'm always so grateful to Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Baby's breath it is, theeeen!
Thank you very much, Trainer!

"—Afterward, El Condor Pasa made a bouquet
of white and pink baby's breath
and gave it to Grass Wonder."

Apparently, Grass Wonder smiled and said,
"Did you know that flower meanings change
depending on their color?"
